The added supply pushes the ETF price back toward NAV. At a discount the AP does the reverse: it buys ETF shares and redeems them for the basket.

distractorExplanations.a: That is the discount trade; buying ETF shares at a premium and redeeming them for the cheaper basket locks in a loss.
distractorExplanations.b: Also a discount trade: it buys the overpriced ETF and shorts the relatively cheap basket, losing the 0.6% gap.
distractorExplanations.c: Holding the basket unhedged is a directional bet, not an arbitrage; the gap is captured by creating and selling new ETF shares.
